title: My Former Daughter-In-Law Forged Dissolution, Sold My Studio, Sent $4,300. So I Voided The Sale
description: After 30 years as a mail carrier, I retired and put $132,000 into a vintage watch restoration studio with my former daughter-in-law. She forged a dissolution, sold the restored Patek Philippe inventory and client list for $710,000, and mailed me a $4,300 mainspring check. I recovered the original notarized agreement from Arthur's hollowed watch case, voided the sale, and now she polishes crystals in a Wound Me Out smock. #RevengeStory #FamilyBetrayal #Karma
thumb_text: SHE FORGED THE SALE. I VOIDED IT ALL
pinned_comment: What would you do if your former daughter-in-law forged a dissolution and sent you a $4,300 check after selling the Patek Philippe inventory you both built for $710,000? If something like this has happened to you, please share your story in the comments.
